name: USM FUM defund split-invariance
summary: USM.defund() prices a FUM redemption off the mean of the current and post-redemption sell price and contracts adjShrinkFactor per call, so redeeming one position in 64 slices paid strictly more ETH than one call - a pure rounding/split-invariance flaw with identical oracle reads throughout the trace.
notes: The CREATE2 deployment installed the direct USM runtime containing the FUM pricing logic, and the same runtime remained active through the exploit.

Gross loss is the exact USM balance decrease in the exploit transaction after excluding the flash-loan round trip. The latest CoinGecko ETH observation before the transaction values it at $135,809.90.
